ja: エンジニア：うーん、どうしたもんか……
ああ、どうも、はじめまして。

key: I'm up here investigating how we can reappropriate this plant for the City Restoration Project.
en: I'm up here investigating how we can reappropriate this plant for the City Restoration Project.
ja: 今、この施設を都市復興プロジェクトのために再利用できないか、調べているところなんだ。

key: Or... I would be, but the room to the generator in the back seems to be locked.
en: Or... I would be, but the room to the generator in the back seems to be locked.
ja: ……のはずなんだけど、奥の発電機室に鍵がかかっているみたいでね。

key: I've already called down to the Grand Hall, and no one seems to have it.
en: I've already called down to the Grand Hall, and no one seems to have it.
ja: もう大ホールに電話してみたんだけど、誰も鍵を持っていないみたいなんだ。

key: And this building belonged to the Yureyu Company, so they would have the key, only...
en: And this building belonged to the Yureyu Company, so they would have the key, only...
ja: それに、この建物はユーレユ社のものだったから、本来なら鍵を持っているはずなんだけど……

key: There is the small problem that they no longer exist.
en: There is the small problem that they no longer exist.
ja: 困ったことに、その会社はもう存在していなくてね。
やっぱり無理なのかもな……
\PNはユーレユのカギを見せた。

key: TECHIE: Ehh? Do you mean that that key is to the plant generator?
en: TECHIE: Ehh? Do you mean that that key is to the plant generator?
ja: エンジニア：ええっ? それって、発電機の鍵ってこと?

key: How in the world did you find it? This is wonderful!
en: How in the world did you find it? This is wonderful!
ja: いったいどこで見つけたんだ? これはすごい!

key: You go ahead and unlock the place and have a look around and I'll report back to the city that we can make progress!
en: You go ahead and unlock the place and have a look around and I'll report back to the city that we can make progress!
ja: さあ、鍵を開けて中を見てきてくれ。オレは市に進展があったと報告してくるよ!

key: Oh! And hold onto this while you do.
en: Oh! And hold onto this while you do.
ja: あ! それと、これを持っていってくれ。

key: I found it when I was digging around in there.
en: I found it when I was digging around in there.
ja: あの中を掘り返してたときに見つけたんだ。

key: I'm not sure what it is, but it could be important.
en: I'm not sure what it is, but it could be important.
ja: 何なのかはよくわからないけど、大事なものかもしれない。
本当に助かったよ、それじゃあな!
扉には鍵がかかっている。
